scope: Pinned complete county address snapshot for the owner-requested address-search fix. Public county artifacts carry the index and search locally on demand; this does not deploy, change sharing, or verify trail access.

license.attribution: Contains McLean County, Illinois address data from the county's public 'Addresses' ArcGIS item (502eefa828f94f749bbab9da63b0d016), licensed CC BY 4.0. Trail Mapper reduced it to address text, postal community, postal code and point, normalized the text, rounded points to 1e-6 degrees and removed non-McLean and unnumbered rows. This is not the county's own product and is not endorsed by the county.
license.changesMade: reduced fields; address text upper-cased with punctuation removed and directional and street-type words made canonical; points rounded to 1e-6 degrees; rows outside McLean County, without a leading house number, without a point, or exact duplicates removed (counts below)

transform.deterministic: verified at build time: the same rows in reverse order give the identical index bytes

notIncluded: any personal route, position, or typed text
owner or property data other than the address text and point
blockers: Deployment is held separately. Address points do not establish trail access; unverified connections still block Start.
operationalUnknowns: Availability and rate tolerance of the county service for repeated bulk queries is unknown. It is an operational question, not a missing licence permission for the already downloaded, CC BY-labelled bytes.
Currency of the rows: the item was last modified 2022-09-06; whether the rows are newer is not established.

featureRequest.purpose: Fix reported inability to search addresses
